label: GENERATED by labs/ch20/L20.2-controlled-adoption-experiment/scripts/generate_data.py; synthetic and configured
question: Do coding agents on the paved road shorten change lead time for the integrations and analytics teams' work, without raising the change fail rate or overloading reviewers?

primary_outcome.summary: ratio of geometric means, agent over control, within engineer

multiplicity: secondary outcomes are reported unadjusted and read as descriptive; only the primary outcome is tested for a decision

randomization.method: permuted blocks of four within team and size estimate, generated before the start by the data steward from a fixed seed

comparison_group: mobile and marketplace teams, concurrent, catalog tools without agents; within the pilot teams, control tasks done without agents

contamination.risk: engineers carry agent-written code or habits into control tasks
contamination.mitigation: control tasks are done with agents switched off in the workspace; the bias is toward no difference, and the readout says so

contamination.risk: agent changes lengthen the shared review queue for control changes too
contamination.mitigation: review wait is reported per arm and per team against the comparison teams

contamination.risk: comparison teams use personal AI tools
contamination.mitigation: the acceptable-use policy and the anonymous pulse survey's shadow-AI question

power.assumptions: sd_team_period 0.10, sd_heterogeneity 0.10, contamination_task 0.20, 1.92 changes per engineer-week (the baseline's), 13 weeks; components from the Q4 2026 baseline

analysis.estimate: within-engineer difference of mean log hours, averaged over engineers
analysis.interval: paired t interval over engineers' differences, 95% (14 degrees of freedom); a percentile cluster bootstrap is printed as a check
analysis.test: paired t-test on engineers' mean log differences
analysis.robustness_check: exact sign test over engineers' differences
analysis.interim_looks: none; the readout uses all thirteen weeks

guardrails.threshold: agent minus control at most +5 points
pilot-to-comparison ratio of median review wait at most 1.5 times the same ratio in the baseline quarter
guardrails.window: rolling four weeks, and the whole pilot

decision_rule: Expand only if the guardrails hold; if lead time shows no clear change, expand in waves that keep a comparison and re-measure each wave.
